options.label: Graphics backend
options.description: How Dolphin draws the game. Vulkan is usually the fastest; Software is far too slow to play and is only for checking graphics bugs.

options.label: Internal resolution
options.description: Draws the game's 3D at a multiple of the console's resolution for a sharper picture. Higher costs speed.

options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: The shape of the picture. Game's own follows what the game asks for (4:3 or 16:9).

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: How the picture is scaled up to the screen. Sharp keeps edges crisp; Smooth blends them.

options.label: Widescreen hack
options.description: Makes 4:3 games draw a wider 16:9 view. Can show glitches at the screen edges; set the aspect ratio to 16:9 with it.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Waits for the screen's refresh to stop tearing. Can add a little input lag.

options.label: Input latency
options.description: Low starts each frame as late as it can still make the screen, so the game reads the controller later and a press shows up sooner (about 25 ms sooner for a light game on a 60 Hz panel). It only acts with VSync on and the Vulkan renderer, and turns itself off while frames take most of a refresh, so a heavy game is unaffected. Normal is the standard timing.

options.label: Show FPS
options.description: Shows the frame rate in a corner of the screen.

notes: Verified against dolphin-emu tag 2609 (f84df02). Dolphin.ini [Core] GFXBackend is a string of the backend's config name: Source/Core/Core/Config/MainSettings.cpp:250; names 'Vulkan', 'OGL', 'Software Renderer' in Source/Core/VideoBackends/{Vulkan,OGL,Software}/VideoBackend.h CONFIG_NAME (Null and the Windows/macOS ones are left out). Linux builds list OGL and Vulkan (HAS_OPENGL/HAS_VULKAN): Source/Core/VideoCommon/VideoBackendBase.cpp:202-220.

GFX.ini (System::GFX, F_GFXCONFIG_IDX, Source/Core/Common/CommonPaths.h:108) is not seeded: the first patch creates it with only our [section] key = value lines. The base loader copies whatever keys an ini has into the layer and leaves every other key at its default (Source/Core/Core/ConfigLoaders/BaseConfigLoader.cpp:146-176; IniFile::Load of a missing file just yields no sections). The ini parser strips spaces around '=' (Source/Core/Common/IniFile.cpp ParseLine).

Keys and sections: [Settings] InternalResolution int (GFX_EFB_SCALE, default 1 = native, 0 = auto; Source/Core/Core/Config/GraphicsSettings.cpp:91), [Settings] AspectRatio (GraphicsSettings.cpp:22), [Settings] wideScreenHack (:21), [Settings] ShowFPS (:45), [Hardware] VSync (:16), [Enhancements] OutputResampling (:146). The GUI labels 2x/3x/4x 'for 720p/1080p/1440p' (Source/Core/DolphinQt/Config/Graphics/EnhancementsWidget.cpp:69-77).

AspectRatio is the AspectMode enum stored as its int: 0 Auto, 1 ForceWide (16:9), 2 ForceStandard (4:3), 3 Stretch (Source/Core/VideoCommon/VideoConfig.h:22-31; enums parse via their underlying int, Source/Core/Common/Config/Layer.h:37-44). 'Game's own' (Auto) follows the game's widescreen flag, helped by SuggestedAspectRatio in Sys GameSettings.

Screen filter = Output Resampling (Source/Core/VideoCommon/VideoConfig.h:68-77): 0 Default (the GPU's bilinear sampler, fastest) for Smooth, 5 Sharp Bilinear for Sharp (Data/Sys/Shaders/default_pre_post_process.glsl:389). Dolphin has no nearest-neighbour output choice in its enum, and no integer scaling, so integer_scale is left out. Needs post-processing support: OGL and Vulkan have it (Source/Core/VideoBackends/OGL/OGLMain.cpp:122, Vulkan/VulkanContext.cpp:438); the Software renderer does not.
Booleans are written True/False as Dolphin writes them (ValueToString(bool), Source/Core/Common/StringUtil.cpp:318-321; TryParse accepts true/false in any case or 1/0, :269-281).

Settings are read at boot from the config layers (Source/Core/VideoCommon/VideoConfig.cpp:83-152); -b -e does not touch them. Precedence: Data/Sys/GameSettings set none of these keys at 2609 (only SuggestedAspectRatio and widescreen heuristics), but a player's own per-game GameSettings ini (Dolphin's game Properties) outranks GFX.ini/Dolphin.ini.
